input.summary: Insert vendor insurance covenant as new § 20(k)
input.comment: [Playbook] Garman installs and maintains the Software at our Authorized Locations and converts our data, so we need it to carry standard cover. We have added a short insurance covenant (commercial general liability USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where our data is processed, plus statutory workers' compensation and certificates on request); we can accept E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M as a fallback.

ops.text: (k) Garman shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; where Garman processes Sparkling's data, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. Garman shall provide Sparkling with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage on request.
